headline.caveat: MGX + Oracle together hold ~20% of Stargate LLC; the individual split and MGX's capital commitment are undisclosed

nature_md: Abu Dhabi's MGX (the UAE sovereign AI investment vehicle) is the fourth initial equity funder of Stargate LLC, sharing ~20% with Oracle. MGX is the program's sovereign-capital leg and the bridge to Stargate UAE (1GW announced, first 200MW live Feb 2026, on which the UAE side committed to matching US-based investment). MGX also participates elsewhere in the same stack it co-owns — it is an investor in OpenAI rounds, a partner in the AI Infrastructure Partnership with BlackRock/Microsoft/NVIDIA, and co-acquirer of Aligned Data Centers ($40B) — making Gulf capital one of the few genuinely external (non-circular) funding sources in the OpenAI cluster, though it appears at multiple layers simultaneously.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Sovereign-fund investment in JV equity; MGX discloses no financials. Its Stargate exposure spans layers: LLC equity, OpenAI equity, and data-center assets (Aligned via AIP) — correlated bets on the same demand.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Equity capitalization of Stargate LLC; sovereign participation also carries geopolitical weight (chip-export and data-sovereignty approvals) that pure financial investors don't bring.
